name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover garage flood damage from rain?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover garage flood damage from rain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance typically covers sudden and accidental water damage, which often includes damage from rain that enters through a breach in the roof or a broken window. However, damage specifically caused by floodwaters, like a river overflowing its banks or widespread area flooding, usually requires a separate flood insurance policy. It's important to review your specific policy documents or contact your insurance provider to understand your coverage for rain-related garage flooding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance may cover rain damage if accidental, but widespread flood damage typically requires separate flood insurance. Check your policy.
